question_text: Ana and Maria have P2,500. Ana has P300 more than Maria. How much does Maria have?

hint_ladder.title: Let Maria=x
hint_ladder.text: Let Maria's amount be x. Since Ana has P300 more, Ana's amount = x + 300.

hint_ladder.title: Total
hint_ladder.text: Together they have P2,500: x + (x + 300) = 2,500. Combine: 2x + 300 = 2,500.

hint_ladder.title: Solve
hint_ladder.text: Subtract 300 from both sides: 2x = 2,200. Divide by 2: x = 1,100.

hint_ladder.title: Answer
hint_ladder.text: So Maria has P1,100. Check: Ana has 1,100+300=1,400, total 1,100+1,400=2,500. Correct!

A.text: You might have chosen A because you subtracted 300 from P2,500 and divided by 2 incorrectly, getting P1,000.

B.text: Correct. Maria has P1,100, Ana has P1,400, total P2,500.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you added the P300 difference to the total before dividing, getting P1,200.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you solved for Ana's amount by adding then dividing, giving P1,400.

next_time_rule: **Next Time Rule:** Itabi si Maria bilang x. Total = x + (x + diff). Bawasan ang total ng diff, then ÷2 para makuha si x.
deconstruct_text:
Magkaibigan sina Ana at Maria. Nag-ambag sila para sa kanilang grupo sa Barangay Health Workers. Ang total nilang ipon ay P2,500. Pero sabi ni Ana, 'Akin ang mas maraming P300.' Paano malalaman ang kay Maria?

I-set si Maria = x. So Ana = x+300. Equation: 2x+300=2,500. Solve: (2,500–300)÷2 = 1,100. Mental trick: 'Bawasan ang total ng difference, saka hatiin sa dalawa, para makuha ang mas maliit.'

**Watch-Out Zone: reverse_operation_error** – Pag-add ng diff sa total ay pera ni Ana, ...

Double-check: 1,100 (Maria) + 1,400 (Ana) = 2,500. Sakto! Kaya ang tamang sagot ay B – P1,100.
